title: DatabasePluginOption configsetting Section Wrong
author: springmin

comments.body:
Is there an issue?

This was experted when I implemented that in order to simplify the options settings.

maybe，it is  not a rigorous issue. but i think the GetSection("memory") returned value structue("Kind,Host,Port,Dimensions" or "ConnectionString,Dimensions") bind to DatabasePluginOptions (property is "TopK,MaxTokens,Temperature,TopP"). the DatabasePluginOptions keep a default value is a simplify , but fixed it is a better choice for keeping  configurability 。
By the way， the prompts  in files is better  in resourcestream, the LRM and the LLM have different prompts.

I made this intentionally to make the configuration "simple"; Otherwise following the isolation required, I'ld have to make sections for memory (only kind), then a section qdrant (Host, port, Dimensions), sqlite (connectionString, Dimensions), and next for all DBs.

But you're right, I can also add a section dedicated to the plugin. I'll take a look into it.

See #34 regarding the prompts
